name: Mehrangarh Fort
description: A majestic 15th-century fort towering over Jodhpur, offering panoramic views and rich history with intricate palaces and museums inside.

name: Jaswant Thada
description: A stunning marble cenotaph built in memory of Maharaja Jaswant Singh II, known for its delicate lattice work and peaceful gardens.

name: Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum
description: A grand palace blending Art Deco and Indian architecture, part of which is a museum showcasing royal artifacts and vintage cars.

name: Clock Tower & Sardar Market
description: Bustling local market around the iconic Clock Tower, perfect for shopping spices, textiles, handicrafts, and experiencing local life.

name: Mandore Gardens
description: Historic gardens with royal cenotaphs, temples, and a museum, offering a serene escape and insight into Jodhpur’s ancient capital.

name: Rao Jodha Desert Rock Park
description: A unique ecological park created to restore the natural desert landscape around Mehrangarh Fort, featuring native flora and walking trails.

name: Chamunda Mata Temple
description: A revered temple dedicated to Goddess Chamunda, located within Mehrangarh Fort, known for its spiritual ambiance and intricate carvings.

name: Toorji Ka Jhalra (Stepwell)
description: An ancient stepwell with beautiful architecture and a peaceful atmosphere, a hidden gem showcasing traditional water conservation methods.

name: Kaylana Lake
description: A scenic artificial lake surrounded by hills, ideal for picnics, bird watching, and enjoying tranquil sunsets away from the city bustle.

name: Balsamand Lake and Garden
description: A historic artificial lake with a charming garden and palace, perfect for a peaceful stroll and enjoying nature’s beauty.

name: Machia Biological Park
description: A wildlife sanctuary featuring native and exotic animals, offering safari rides and a chance to see wildlife in a naturalistic setting.

name: Ghanta Ghar (Old Clock Tower)
description: The iconic clock tower in the heart of Jodhpur’s old city, a popular meeting point surrounded by vibrant bazaars.

name: Nathji Ki Haveli
description: A beautifully preserved haveli showcasing traditional Rajasthani architecture with intricate frescoes and wooden carvings.

name: Mandore Stepwell
description: An ancient stepwell near Mandore Gardens, featuring impressive stonework and a glimpse into historic water management.

name: Ratanada Ganesh Temple
description: A popular temple dedicated to Lord Ganesha, known for its vibrant festivals and spiritual atmosphere in the city center.

name: Jodhpur Ropeway
description: A thrilling cable car ride offering spectacular aerial views of Mehrangarh Fort and the blue cityscape below.

name: Phool Mahal
description: An exquisite palace hall inside Mehrangarh Fort, adorned with intricate mirror work and floral decorations, once used for royal gatherings.

name: Chameli Bagh
description: A lesser-known garden with fragrant jasmine flowers and shaded walkways, ideal for a quiet retreat in the city.

name: Sardar Government Museum
description: A museum showcasing artifacts, sculptures, and paintings that narrate the rich cultural heritage of Jodhpur and Rajasthan.

name: Bishnoi Village Safari
description: An immersive experience visiting the Bishnoi community, known for their wildlife conservation, traditional crafts, and rural lifestyle.
